Track model usage

Unity AI Gateway logs usage data to system.ai_gateway.usage.

Column name Type Description Example
account_id STRING Account. id
workspace_id STRING Workspace. id
request_id STRING Request. id
invocation_id STRING Invocation. id
endpoint_id STRING Endpoint. id
endpoint_name STRING Endpoint. name
event_time TIMESTAMP Time. time
destination_type STRING Type. type
destination_name STRING Name. name
destination_model STRING Model. model
input_tokens LONG Input. 1
output_tokens LONG Output. 1
total_tokens LONG Total. 2
token_details STRUCT Detailed token breakdown including cache_read_input_tokens, cache_creation_input_tokens, and output_reasoning_tokens. {}
status_code INTEGER Status. 200
routing_information STRUCT Routing. {}

Limitations

Unity AI Gateway doesn't track token usage for non-streaming, non-embedding responses larger than 1 MiB.
